amount.description: Distance in CSS pixels (default: most of the viewport)

ref.description: Element to scroll into view (without direction), or to scroll inside (with direction)

x.description: With direction: scroll what is under this point (CSS pixels of the viewport)

y.description: With direction: scroll what is under this point (CSS pixels of the viewport)

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
